title: Doduo’s Two Heads Are Running Stabilizers

direction.premise: Doduo’s short wings make flying difficult, so it runs while alternating its heads to stay more stable.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Doduo’s short wings lead to a surprising head rhythm for stable running.
direction.openLoop: If flying is difficult, why do Doduo’s heads alternate while it runs?
direction.payoff: Doduo’s short wings make flight difficult, while its alternating heads help stabilize high-speed running.
direction.engagementQuestion: Would you call it clever balance or strange design?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and clearly. Stress “flies poorly,” “alternating,” and “more stable.” Pause briefly after each short sentence. End with a playful challenge.

scenes.headline: FLIGHT FAILS. RUNNING WORKS.
scenes.narration: Doduo flies poorly, but its heads steady its run.
scenes.caption: DIFFICULT FLIGHT. STEADIER RUNNING.

scenes.headline: SHORT WINGS, FAST FEET
scenes.narration: Its short wings make flying difficult, so it runs at high speed.
scenes.caption: SHORT WINGS. HIGH-SPEED RUNNING.

scenes.headline: ONE RISES, ONE LOWERS
scenes.narration: At speed, Doduo raises one head while lowering the other.
scenes.caption: UP. DOWN. UP. DOWN.

scenes.headline: THE RHYTHM BUILDS BALANCE
scenes.narration: That alternating motion helps Doduo balance itself for a more stable run.
scenes.caption: ALTERNATING HEADS. MORE STABILITY.

scenes.headline: THE GROUND IS THE ADVANTAGE
scenes.narration: Short wings make flight difficult. This head rhythm supports high-speed running.
scenes.caption: DIFFICULT FLIGHT. STABLE RUNNING.

scenes.headline: CLEVER BALANCE OR STRANGE DESIGN?
scenes.narration: Would you call it clever balance or strange design?
scenes.caption: CLEVER OR STRANGE?
